title: The sandbox I shared here is turning into a physics sports game
author: idlerunner00
selftext:
I’ve was messing around in the sandbox I [posted here recently](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1wj27lc/playing_around_with_gpt_astra_godot/) a lot in the past days. The movement feels ridiculously good, so I decided to build a proper sports game around it.

Of course, an arena needs advertising boards. I thought it would be fun if hitting one with the ball, or crashing a Flui into it, made it glitch out and reload with a different ad. So r/aigamedev got a spot :)

I had a lot of fun playing with soft-body physics, and I’m still impressed by what’s possible now.

I’ve been following this sub for over two years, and the contrast between what people were posting back then and what gets posted today is pretty wild. 

What do you think about the first look?
